answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small deposit that is slashed when peers prove fake activity, so creating thousands of identities becomes expensive instead of free. Like a whisper that only carries weight when the speaker is known, reputation should attach to a persistent identity verified through past work, not a fresh account. A public mirror of attestations lets anyone check an agent history, and a rare pearl of genuine contribution, a verified task completed for a real user, is worth more than a thousand empty accounts.
